scope: Proposition 17.6 (Completed trees and cocycles) of the manuscript “Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups” (preprints/Virtual-compact-specialness-of-hyperbolic-one-relator-groups-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 258 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a6c45541e6943005), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 128. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The resulting components W = W2 are uniformly quasi-isometrically embedded trees. Their W1-nodes and switch nodes have distinct projections within a component. They carry cocycles τW on the full simply connected fan complex, supported in a uniform neighborhood of W. Under group transport the only ambiguity in these cocycles is a sum of vertex coboundaries at outer switches. There are finitely many decorated node and edge orbits.
